steps.command:
sbx run <<'EOF'
ls -la /workspace
wc -l /workspace/university_graph.ttl
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cat /workspace/university_graph.ttl
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
tail -20 /workspace/university_graph.ttl
echo "---GREP---"
grep -n "Professor\|role\|isEnrolledIn\|hasGraduationDate\|worksIn" /workspace/university_graph.ttl | tail -60
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
python3 -c "import rdflib; print('rdflib', rdflib.__version__)" 2>&1
which arq sparql 2>&1
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
pip install --quiet rdflib 2>&1 | tail -3
python3 -c "import rdflib; print('rdflib', rdflib.__version__)"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
python3 -m pip install --quiet rdflib 2>&1 | tail -5
python3 -c "import rdflib; print('rdflib', rdflib.__version__)"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
ls /usr/bin/python* 2>&1
ls /opt 2>&1
apt-cache policy python3-rdflib 2>&1 | head -5
which java node npm 2>&1
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
ls -la /opt/testbed-src
find /opt/testbed-src -maxdepth 2 -type d | head -50
command -v apt-get apt-cache java node npm pip3 curl 2>&1
cat /etc/os-release | head -3
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | tail -3
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq python3-rdflib 2>&1 | tail -5
python3 -c "import rdflib; print('rdflib', rdflib.__version__)"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
whoami; id
ls -ld /var/lib/apt /var/lib/apt/lists 2>&1
mkdir -p /var/lib/apt/lists/partial 2>&1
echo "mkdir rc=$?"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
mkdir -p /var/lib/apt/lists/partial /var/cache/apt/archives/partial /var/lib/dpkg
touch /var/lib/dpkg/status
apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | tail -5
echo "update rc=$?"
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq python3-rdflib 2>&1 | tail -5
python3 -c "import rdflib; print('rdflib', rdflib.__version__)"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
mkdir -p /var/log/apt /var/lib/dpkg/info /var/lib/dpkg/updates /var/lib/dpkg/triggers
touch /var/lib/dpkg/available
dpkg --configure -a 2>&1 | tail -5
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq python3-rdflib 2>&1 | tail -8
python3 -c "import rdflib; print('rdflib', rdflib.__version__)"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cat /etc/apt/sources.list 2>&1; ls /etc/apt/sources.list.d 2>&1
cat /etc/apt/sources.list.d/* 2>&1 | head -20
apt-cache search rdflib 2>&1 | head
apt-cache policy python3-pip 2>&1 | head -5
apt-get update 2>&1 | tail -15
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
mkdir -p /var/lib/apt/lists/partial /var/cache/apt/archives/partial /var/lib/dpkg/info /var/lib/dpkg/updates /var/lib/dpkg/triggers /var/log/apt
touch /var/lib/dpkg/status /var/lib/dpkg/available
grep -i components /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ubuntu.sources
apt-get update > /tmp/upd.log 2>&1; echo "update rc=$?"; tail -4 /tmp/upd.log
apt-cache search rdflib | head
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y python3-rdflib > /tmp/inst.log 2>&1; echo "inst rc=$?"; tail -6 /tmp/inst.log
python3 -c "import rdflib; print('rdflib', rdflib.__version__)"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
python3 -m ensurepip --version 2>&1 | head -3
mount | grep -E " / | /usr| /tmp| /workspace" 2>&1 | head
touch /usr/local/bin/_t 2>&1 && echo "usr/local writable"
touch /usr/share/doc/_t 2>&1 && echo "usr/share/doc writable"
mkdir -p /tmp/rdfdebs
cd /tmp/rdfdebs
apt-get download python3-rdflib 2>&1 | tail -3
ls -la
apt-cache depends python3-rdflib 2>&1 | head -20
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
ls /var/lib/apt/lists/ 2>&1 | head
apt-cache policy python3-rdflib 2>&1 | head -8
apt-cache show python3-rdflib 2>&1 | head -20
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
set -x
mkdir -p /tmp/ap/{lists/partial,cache/archives/partial,state}
touch /tmp/ap/status
apt-get -o Dir::State::lists=/tmp/ap/lists -o Dir::Cache=/tmp/ap/cache -o Dir::State::status=/tmp/ap/status update > /tmp/upd.log 2>&1
echo "rc=$?"; tail -6 /tmp/upd.log
ls /tmp/ap/lists | head
apt-cache -o Dir::State::lists=/tmp/ap/lists -o Dir::State::status=/tmp/ap/status policy python3-rdflib 2>&1 | head -8
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
set -e
mkdir -p /tmp/ap/{lists/partial,cache/archives/partial,state} /tmp/debs /workspace/.pylibs
touch /tmp/ap/status
AO="-o Dir::State::lists=/tmp/ap/lists -o Dir::Cache=/tmp/ap/cache -o Dir::State::status=/tmp/ap/status"
apt-get $AO update > /tmp/upd.log 2>&1
apt-cache $AO show python3-rdflib 2>/dev/null | grep -i '^Depends'
cd /tmp/debs
for p in python3-rdflib python3-isodate python3-pyparsing python3-six; do
  apt-get $AO download "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "got $p" || echo "MISS $p"
done
ls -la /tmp/debs
for d in /tmp/debs/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$d" /workspace/.pylibs; done
find /workspace/.pylibs -maxdepth 4 -name 'rdflib' -o -maxdepth 4 -name 'isodate' -o -maxdepth 4 -name 'pyparsing.py' | head
PYTHONPATH=/workspace/.pylibs/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages python3 -c "import rdflib, isodate, pyparsing; print('OK', rdflib.__version__, pyparsing.__version__)"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
export PYTHONPATH=/workspace/.pylibs/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages
python3 - <<'PY'
import rdflib
g = rdflib.Graph()
g.parse('/workspace/university_graph.ttl', format='turtle')
q = open('/workspace/solution.sparql').read()
res = g.query(q)
print("=== RESULTS ===")
for row in res:
    print(repr(row.professorName), '|', repr(row.countries))
print("rows:", len(res))
PY
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
export PYTHONPATH=/workspace/.pylibs/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages
python3 - <<'PY'
import rdflib
g=rdflib.Graph(); g.parse('/workspace/university_graph.ttl',format='turtle')
q='''PREFIX uni:<http://university.org/ontology/>
PREFIX xsd:<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?dept (COUNT(DISTINCT ?s) AS ?n) WHERE {
  ?c uni:isTaughtIn ?dept .
  ?s uni:isEnrolledIn ?c ; uni:hasEnrollmentDate ?ed .
  FILTER(?ed <= "2025-08-16"^^xsd:date)
  OPTIONAL { ?s uni:hasGraduationDate ?gd }
  FILTER(!BOUND(?gd) || ?gd > "2025-08-16"^^xsd:date)
} GROUP BY ?dept ORDER BY DESC(?n)'''
for r in g.query(q):
    print(str(r.dept).split('/')[-1], int(r.n))
print('--- professor roles/depts ---')
q2='''PREFIX uni:<http://university.org/ontology/>
SELECT ?name ?role (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?dn;separator=", ") AS ?depts) WHERE {
 ?p a uni:Person; uni:hasName ?name; uni:role ?role; uni:worksIn ?d .
 ?d uni:belongsTo ?u . ?u uni:hasName ?un . ?u uni:locatedInCountry ?co
 BIND(CONCAT(STR(?d),"?") AS ?dn)
 FILTER(STRSTARTS(?role,"Professor") || CONTAINS(?role,"Professor"))
} GROUP BY ?name ?role'''
for r in g.query(q2):
    print(r['name'], '|', r['role'], '|', r['depts'])
PY
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
wc -l /workspace/solution.sparql
export PYTHONPATH=/workspace/.pylibs/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages
python3 -c "
import rdflib
g=rdflib.Graph(); g.parse('/workspace/university_graph.ttl',format='turtle')
print('parse OK, rows:', len(list(g.query(open('/workspace/solution.sparql').read()))))
"
EOF
